result.topic_en: Reading notes listing works by Herder, Berkeley, Thibaut and Cauchy, followed by a generalized ellipsograph in which a linkage point traces an ellipse composed of two opposite circular motions.

Exercitationes Tuong[?]
Ellipsograph generalisirt
[figure: points a, b, c, d; lines ab, bc, bd, dc; c on a vertical line, a on a horizontal line]
$ab = bc$
d beschreibt eine aus zwei entgegengesetzten Kreisbewegungen mit Rad. $ab$ u. $bd$ zusammengesetzte
also Ellipse mit halben Axen $ab+bd$ u. $ab-bd$

methods.what: Generalized ellipsograph linkage: with ab = bc, a point d attached to b traces an ellipse, because its motion is the composition of two opposite circular motions of radii ab and bd; the semi-axes of the ellipse are ab+bd and ab-bd
